summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a PDMR share transaction notification. Regis Simard, President, Global Supply Chain, sold 38,000 ordinary shares at GBP 20.38 per share on the London Stock Exchange on July 29, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of an insider share sale under UK market abuse rules, mapped to a standard SEC insider transaction report. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The filing is purely administrative and informational, providing no strategic or corporate action implications for shareholders.
